verdict.rationale: Insomnia is an API client, design, testing, and mocking tool. Routing, load-balancing, and transforming live traffic between consumers and upstream services is an API-gateway function, which is outside this product's category. Nothing in the evidence shows Insomnia proxying or balancing traffic. The Konnect/Kong Gateway references point to separate Kong products, and pre-request scripts only modify the client's own outgoing requests.
